protocol.title: Keirin Chat continuity / capacity-proof operating protocol v1

current_research_objective: Reach scientific validation 100% primarily through historical virtual-world simulation using only pre-race information available at each historical point. Realtime/current/future race dependence is deferred to the final confirmation stage unless a question is uniquely impossible to reproduce historically. Preserve anti-leak, no-retune and exact-circumference discipline.

active_datasets_and_artifacts.next: score all 9 after official outcomes without deletion or retune; this is retained as already-created final-stage quality evidence but does not control research throughput

active_datasets_and_artifacts.finding: Two independent 335m days differ materially; do not tune from either.
Exact-500m descriptive performance remains stable across current evidence.
Historical source pages can expose outcomes; simulator must reconstruct PRE inputs separately and classify evidence honestly.

active_datasets_and_artifacts.next: Use historical exact-500m virtual-world simulations now; revisit genuine prospective 500m only near final confirmation.

immutable_rule_summary: Historical virtual-world simulation is now the primary path until final live confirmation (KR-016).
Offline simulation does not require live odds unless an experiment specifically tests odds.
Odds belong at live/manual purchase boundary.
Historical simulation must use only fields available before the simulated race; outcomes are kept out of predictor inputs.
Historical racecard URLs are not proof of blindness; evidence class must reflect source leakage risk.
Exact circumference is preserved; no 335->333.3 or 500->400 coercion.
No guessing missing PRE fields; no cherry-picking; no retune.
GitHub is canonical continuity state; chat is ephemeral.

latest_completed_experiments.result: 7/20 top1=35.0%; 14/20 winner Top3=70.0%; weighted log loss 1.74501; material day-to-day heterogeneity retained
25/55 top1=45.45%; 43/55 winner Top3=78.18%; weighted log loss 1.54753; descriptive retrospective only
9/9 frozen before outcomes; scoring pending; retained but no longer throughput-critical

exact_next_executable_actions: Expand historical virtual-world simulation across all retrievable complete historical racecards, separated by exact circumference, venue, class/grade, day type and race structure.
For each batch reconstruct PRE-only inputs first, freeze predictions, then join outcomes for scoring; never use target result/payout/odds as predictor inputs.

Evaluate top1, winner-in-Top3, log loss/calibration, stability across dates/venues/classes, finals-vs-qualifiers, solo-rider presence, line structure and other predeclared dimensions; reject unstable findings and do not retune confirmatory sets.
Accumulate enough independent historical evidence to settle model structure and purchase-rule research before returning to a small final genuine realtime confirmation gate.
progress_rule: Do not increase progress merely because files or case counts grow; increase only when evidence strength materially advances.
